title: Ginger Beef Stir Fry

items.description: red bell pepper, stemmed, cored, and thinly sliced
bunch green onion, green ends cut on the bias

steps: Combine all sauce ingredients, whisking until smooth, set aside.
In a hot pan, add oil and heat until shimmering. Cook the beef for about 3 minutes. Tenderize first if needed.
Remove the beef and lightly season with salt. Wipe out pan, leaving some oil behind.
Over medium heat, adding a drizzle of oil if needed, saute chopped garlic until fragrant.
Increase heat to medium-high and add the bell pepper, onion, and ginger. Stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Return the beef to the pan, pour in the sauce, and toss everything together until well coated and heated through.
Turn the heat off, add green onions, and stir well. Serve stir fry with white rice.
